premise: a dark fantasy action RPG of forges, ruins and old gold

slots.name: fantasy/panel
slots.note: A dark charcoal-brown slab with a faint worn, mottled painted texture, darkest in the middle; a thin double border of antique gold a few pixels inside its edge, with a little gold scrollwork at each corner; the centre plain and dark so light text reads on it. As the frame of the concept's settings and shop panels. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/card
slots.note: A dark item tile as in the concept's shop grid: deep charcoal fill with a soft inner vignette, a thin bronze-gold hairline border with a tiny filigree point at each corner; plain and dark inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/field
slots.note: A dark recessed input box as the settings' Output device select: near-black fill, one thin muted-gold border line, square corners slightly bevelled; plain inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/slot
slots.note: An empty square inventory and ability socket as the HUD's action bar: a dark recessed well inside a bevelled dark-iron rim with a thin gold edge and small gold filigree at the four corners; no icon, plain dark inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/tooltip
slots.note: A small dark plate with a thin antique-gold border; plain dark inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/hud
slots.note: A slim HUD chip plate for small readouts (a timer, a score, lives): a dark iron face with a thin antique-gold rim and a tiny gold point at each corner, the corner details no wider than a fifth of its height; plain dark inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/button
slots.note: The secondary button, as the settings' DONE button: a dark charcoal face, a thin antique-gold frame with small notched filigree corners; no text, no icon. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/button-primary
slots.note: The primary button, as the shop's BUY button: a flat, light golden face of one even colour, about #E0A646 (between #D99A3A and #E8B14A), across the whole centre with no darker band, gradient, scratches or vignette, so dark near-black lettering reads on it at a glance; a thin antique-gold border, a hair darker than the face, with small filigree at the corners; no text, no icon. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: fantasy/corner
slots.note: One top-left corner bracket of ornate antique-gold filigree (two scrolled arms meeting at a small point) as on the concept's panel corners; the bracket only, its arms along the top and left edges of the image.

slots.name: fantasy/divider
slots.note: A thin horizontal antique-gold divider line tapering to points at both ends, with a small diamond at its centre, as under the item name in the shop's detail panel.

slots.name: fantasy/flourish
slots.note: A small antique-gold heading flourish: a short tapering line ending in a scrolled curl at its right end, drawn left to right.

slots.name: fantasy/crest
slots.note: A small symmetrical crest for the top centre of a panel: a red-gemmed diamond set in antique-gold filigree with short scrolled wings to each side.

slots.name: fantasy/edge
slots.note: A slim vertical antique-gold ornament for the middle of a panel's left edge: a small diamond with short filigree stems above and below, symmetrical.

slots.name: fantasy/thumb
slots.note: A slider's thumb: one antique-gold diamond (a square standing on its point, as tall as it is wide), its four facets bevelled, a dark charcoal core at its centre and a 1 px bright gold highlight along its upper edges; as the gold diamond knobs on the concept's volume sliders. It must read at 3:1 or better against a dark brown track and the dark panel. Nothing else: no track, no glow beyond its edge.

slots.name: fantasy/knob
slots.note: A switch's knob when it is on: one round polished antique-gold orb, warm amber at its centre, a dark gold rim and a small soft white highlight at its upper left; as the lit knob of the concept's Subtitles switch. Perfectly circular and filling its square. Nothing else: no track.

slots.name: fantasy/knob-off
slots.note: A switch's knob when it is off: one round worn-bronze orb, muted but clearly lighter than a dark charcoal track (3:1 or better against it), a darker bronze rim and a small soft highlight at its upper left; as the unlit knob of the concept's Mute everything switch. Perfectly circular and filling its square. Nothing else: no track.
